body: What a mouthful. I understand why this remark is here, but it ruins the sentence's flow, because you'd expect the description to go into detail right away. Plus it's the default behaviour, so most don't need to read this. It could be moved at the bottom of the description in its own note.

The engine will start recording as soon as the splash screen is finished, and it will only stop recording when the engine quits. Click the video reel icon again to disable Movie Maker mode.
